name: Account Management
description: Windows MDM settings in the Account Management category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Deletion Policy
properties.description: Configures when profiles will be deleted. Allowed values: 0 (delete immediately upon device returning to a state with no currently active users); 1 (delete at storage capacity threshold); 2 (delete at both storage capacity threshold and profile inactivity threshold).

enum.description: Delete immediately upon device returning to a state with no currently active users)
Delete at both storage capacity threshold and profile inactivity threshold

properties.name: Enable Profile Manager
properties.description: Enable profile lifetime mangement for shared or communal device scenarios.

properties.name: Profile Inactivity Threshold
properties.description: Start deleting profiles when they have not been logged on during the specified period, given as number of days.

properties.name: Storage Capacity Start Deletion
properties.description: Start deleting profiles when available storage capacity falls below this threshold, given as percent of total storage available for profiles. Profiles that have been inactive the longest will be deleted first.

properties.name: Storage Capacity Stop Deletion
properties.description: Stop deleting profiles when available storage capacity is brought up to this threshold, given as percent of total storage available for profiles.
